# Speakhold

> Free, open-source dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Hold a key to talk and the words land at the cursor; press record on a call and the notes are written when it ends. No subscription, no bot joins the call, no cloud: Whisper runs on the Mac and the audio is deleted. Notes are written by Claude Code under the user's own plan, their own Claude API key, or Apple Intelligence on-device. MIT licence, native Swift, macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

## Source and install
- Repository: https://github.com/sturzael/speakhold (MIT)
- Download: https://github.com/sturzael/speakhold/releases/latest
- Homebrew: brew install --cask sturzael/tap/speakhold
